∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ} {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (γ : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec (m j) → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (γ j)) →
        (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (γ j)) →
          (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)), 0 ≤ γ j x) →
            ∀ (A : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)) (p : ι → ℝ),
              (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
                ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {U K : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
                  IsOpen U →
                    BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ →
                      IsCompact K →
                        K ⊆ U →
                          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + ∑ j, γ j ((A j) (x - star)) ^ p j) →
                            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F K star

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {Γ : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
      (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (Γ j)) →
        (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
          (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
            ∀ (p : ι → ℝ),
              (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
                ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {U K : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
                  IsOpen U →
                    BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ →
                      IsCompact K →
                        K ⊆ U →
                          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star x) →
                            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F K star

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ}
  (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {Γ : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (Γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
      (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
        ∀ (p : ι → ℝ),
          (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
            ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
              (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
                ∀ {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
                  IsOpen U →
                    BfgsVerification.CenteredSmoothSublinear.LocallyC11On U ψ →
                      IsCompact R.initialSublevel →
                        R.initialSublevel ⊆ U →
                          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star x) →
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun k => F (R.x k)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (F star)) ∧
                              Filter.Tendsto (fun k => BfgsVerification.euclideanSolutionDistance F (R.x k))
                                  Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
                                ((∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F x = F star → x = star) →
                                  Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (𝓝 star))

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {Γ : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
      ∀ (p : ι → ℝ) (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
        t ≤ 1 →
          BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) =
            ∑ j,
              BfgsVerification.RadialPower.profile (p j) t * BfgsVerification.RadialPower.powered (Γ j) (p j) (x - star)

∀ {n m : ℕ} {γ : BfgsVerification.Vec m → ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ →
    ∀ (A : BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec m), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (γ ∘ ⇑A)
